purpose: Record an explicit CANNOT_CHECK for missing live execution of the frozen #8 packet against a Phase-2 closure subject. This is an inventory/evidence-boundary record, not a trial result and not a FAIL laundered from an unrun packet.
verdict_reason: The published packet is intact and pre-outcome, but it binds no corpus/subject (corpus_revision is the literal string UNBOUND) and no merged execution artifact exists on origin/main. A closure-run subject does not exist, so live-packet execution against that subject cannot be checked.
why_cannot_check: corpus_revision is UNBOUND at packet top level and in both task bindings; live_packet.preflight refuses to construct providers against that value.
No Phase-2 closure-run subject exists on origin/main, so there is no subject_revision_hash the packet could be bound to.
No result-bearing live-trial artifact is merged to main. papers/paper-05-self-orion/phase2/LIVE_EXECUTION_TRIGGER.txt is a trigger, not a result.

Actions runs 32000698181, 32002199600, 32002591296 and 32003937947 executed from main and all failed or blocked before a bound closure-subject artifact could be admitted. Their logs are expiring GitHub Actions artifacts, not merged evidence, and they froze subjects other than a #76 closure subject (run 32002591296 froze 6c7d2afb, which is Phase-1-derived by ancestry but is not the closure-run subject, which does not exist).

The merged workflow p5_phase2_live_execution.yml rebuilds a packet from phase2_preflight's in-source registry (phase2:wide:microglia-complement-cross-disease / phase2:deep:mos2-screening-exciton) rather than loading LIVE_TRIAL_PACKET_V1.json. That divergence is owned by sibling lanes (#8 / PR #275 discriminator, #277 / PR #289 fail-closed gate) and is cited here only as a reason execution of the frozen packet cannot be checked from merged main.
what_this_is_not: Not FAIL. FAIL would require a bound execution that produced a negative scientific or process result on the closure subject.
Not PASS. PASS would require a bound execution of the frozen packet plus the rest of gates A-F.
Not a live trial, not a packet rewrite, not a fingerprint recomputation.
Not a substitute for issue #8 closing.
Not admission of the expiring Actions logs as Phase-2 evidence.
reopen_when: A Phase-2 closure subject is frozen on a Phase-1-derived main-line commit.
LIVE_TRIAL_PACKET_V1.json is bound to that subject's corpus_revision without accessing outcomes first.
The merged execution path loads that packet, verifies packet_fingerprint, and identity-checks manifest/evaluator/epoch/baseline/task-set/limits.
A result-bearing artifact is merged to main and content/lineage-bound to the same subject_revision_hash used by the rest of the #76 evidence.
